column1: # Label taxonomy — the single source of truth for this repository's issue labels.
# Format: name <TAB> color (6 hex digits, no #) <TAB> description.
# Blank lines and `#` comments are ignored. `scripts/sync-labels.sh` applies this file to
# GitHub; `scripts/check-issue-triage.sh` gates that every open issue carries a valid
# combination. AGENTS.md §8: the rule lives in a failing command, not in prose someone has
# Ported from reconcile-rs's own `.github/labels.tsv` (same C-/A-/S- dialect, same reasoning
# for what's deliberately absent: no P-/E-/T-/S-stale, no GitHub-native Issue Type/Priority/
# Effort fields -- see that file's header for the full case). Two things adapted for this
#   - A- no longer mirrors a multi-crate workspace (reconcile-rs's five crates): this repo is
#     one crate consuming rsos/rbsr/lww-register/gossip/reconcile as externals, with no
#     internal domain boundary to mirror. The values below are by research concern instead.
#   - M-breaking and the two GitHub-discovery meta labels (`good first issue`, `help wanted`)
#     are dropped: `publish = false`, this crate is never released, so there is no semver
#     contract to protect and no external contributor funnel those two labels exist to serve
#     (Cargo.toml's own "private research companion" description). Revisit if either changes.
# C- — category: what the issue is, i.e. what artifact closes it. Exactly one.

column3: Behaviour, or a probe/bench result, contradicts what README.md or a doc comment claims
A new capability — a ported test, a new probe, a new bench target
Improves existing behaviour — measurement precision, bench coverage — no new capability
Internal quality, hygiene or metadata; no observable behaviour change
Documentation only — no code change closes it
Closes with evidence: a measurement, a reproduction, a bench run
Closes with a written design. The solution space is what is missing
Closes with a recorded call in AGENTS.md. The options are already framed
Umbrella over sub-issues. Carries no work of its own

column1: # A- — area: where it lands. One or more.

column3: The pinned reconcile-rs revision, and re-validating probes/benches when it bumps
The repository itself — its docs, its tracker, its agent instructions, its CI

column1: # S- — status: whether it can be acted on now, and if not, what is in the way. Exactly one.

column3: Not yet classified. The default on anything new; C-/A- are not required until it leaves
Understood, unblocked, and actionable as written
Blocked by another issue, named in the body
Deliberately not now. The body MUST state what would wake it up
